## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete scenario and the new observable behavior.

## Analysis impact

List affected objectives, requirements, rules, models, contract and acceptance IDs.

## Validation

Record actual commands/results and evidence. Distinguish local reference checks from stakeholder acceptance.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and assumptions remain explicit.
- [ ] Documentation, contract and executable behavior agree.
- [ ] Relevant acceptance cases and traceability are updated.
- [ ] No real data, secrets or unsupported business-impact claims are included.
